newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's SPCD to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's SPCD to raise capital.

text.p: Tunisian detergents firm Societe des Produits Chimiques Detergents on Saturday said it plans to raise its capital to six million dinars from four million by capitalising reserves.
The company will issue 400,000 bonus shares, with a nominal value of five dinars each, to current shareholders.
SPCD's net profit for first half 1996 amounted to 1.83 million dinars. In the whole of 1995 net profit was 3.015 million dinars, up 10 percent compared to 1994.

The company was listed on the Tunis Stock Exchange in March after it sold to the public 80,000 shares, of which 14,000 were bought by four foreign institutional investors in the first ever sale of Tunisian shares to foreigners.
